role: Development-guided refinement, not blind final testing

batch: 8fields:4GVmixed-transition,1GVtissue-alternatingPeridermEndoderm,1archivedmixed-transition,1LateralRoot,1explicitBackground; class-balancedCE+.5Dice. Prioritizes user-reviewed roots4/5 without changing labels.
